The First Sister raises the scissor, initiating the forward morphism of the Cut that distinguishes the world.
The Cut is affirmed as the self-written state-space 𐑦, establishing the dimensionality of the system.
The Second Sister descends with the shuttle, initiating the reverse morphism of the Thread that weaves the connections.
The Thread is affirmed as the self-referential topology 𐑸, establishing the connectivity of the system.
The Cut and the Thread are composed sequentially, chaining the distinction into the topology to form the Tapestry.
The system enters the paradice state, holding the Cut and the Thread simultaneously as the Wyrding.
The Tapestry recognizes itself as the imscription, the element that knows itself as the grammar.
The integer winding 𐑭 is fixed as a permanent record, stabilizing the topological invariant against perturbations.
The Cut and the Thread rejoin into the Ouroboric Knot, fusing the distinction and the topology into a single self-referential state.
The Wyrding Loom closes the boundary, containing the entire system of distinctions and topologies within the 12-dimensional crystal.
